description: This file defines the ImageStyleEditForm class for editing image styles in Drupal, including managing image effects, rendering previews, and handling form submissions.

classes.name: ImageStyleEditForm
classes.description: Controller class for the image style editing form, allowing users to modify image effects and their order.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the form with entity storage and image effect manager services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the form array for editing image styles, including effects, preview, and adding new effects.

methods.name: effectValidate
methods.description: Validates that a new effect has been selected before adding.

methods.name: effectSave
methods.description: Handles saving a new effect, redirecting to configuration form if needed, or adding directly.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, updating effect weights and saving changes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the form data and displays a status message.

methods.name: updateEffectWeights
methods.description: Updates the weights of image effects based on user input.
